notes.title: The Release Update!
notes.content:
Hello Ghost Hunters,

Today I will introduce you to the next update!

Today I finally want to take the step and go from Early Access to the final release. The reason for this decision is that I want to look ahead and have started new projects. Through Paranormal Observation I have learned a lot and gained experience for the future. The success of the game has been far greater than I could have dreamed and the feedback has been extremely helpful. I thank each and every one of you for your help and support.

It is not the complete end of the game, updates will surely follow.

The old level data is now immortalized on: https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2150950/leaderboards/9904140/ and the release starts with a new save file.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952534/1b53fc6d12af626e97a03e58867ab6cdda0a5f08.png[/img]
[list]
[*] A Police Map has been added.
[*] New Languages: German, Korean, Chinese, Ukrainian, Russian, Japanese, French, and Spanish.
[*] New Voice Over: I have voiced the German version of the person who calls you.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952534/462f70564a00310009ae103d94a0a8182a137570.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New Images for Upgrades
[*] New Prices: You will gain less experience and money if you die.
[*] Level & Money reset
[/list]


If you have any problems or want to give feedback, you can join the official Discord
https://discord.gg/KCS922fgBK


Have a nice [i]spooky[/i]day!
Your dev Platuro

notes.title: Halloween Update + 1 year later | 10/25/2023
notes.content:
Hello Ghost Hunters,

A year ago I released the game, and the response to the game was much better than I ever expected. I had originally released the game as a demo on another platform. The game was hardly downloaded there and the interest was not very high. Maybe 2-3 people were waiting for the full version. 

I created this game because I wanted to make something different from the other ghost games. I originally planned to release a major update for this event. But unfortunately I can't find the time like I had when I started it. There will be more updates with content, some things are already programmed, but will not be with this update because the new content is still too unstable. I hope that there are no major problems with this Halloween update, because I could create a patch only on Sunday but before the actual Halloween day. 

The game will be fully released when I think it's good enough, that's not the case at the moment. New maps, new items, new ways to use tools is still my mission. After the release I will also work on a new game, the planning is already done. It's a game with a story about a person searching for another person who disappeared under strange circumstances. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952534/1b53fc6d12af626e97a03e58867ab6cdda0a5f08.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New Halloween Theme
[*] Pumpkins everywhere
[/list]

[list]

[/list]
If you have any problems or want to give feedback, you can join the official Discord
https://discord.gg/KCS922fgBK


Have a nice [i]spooky [/i]day!
Your dev Platuro

notes.title: !!!Huge Update!!! - April 1st 2023
notes.content:
[b]Hello Ghost Hunters,[/b]
[i]Today I'm going to introduce you to the next update![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952534/1b53fc6d12af626e97a03e58867ab6cdda0a5f08.png[/img]
[list]
[*] VR support added
[*] It is finally possible to move completely freely by leaving the observation room
[*] Finally new languages - from German to Klingon
[*] Microtransactions - buy the craziest skins for your personal in-game computer
[*] Multiplayer support: player vs. AI, player vs. player
[*] Spooky 🍞: In the basement!
[*] Finally support for RTX, DLSS
[*] Experimental feature: chatting with the ghost using the latest technology from OpenAI.
[*] Some sample questions: 
[List]
[*] How has your day been so far?
[*] Can you help me with my maths exams?
[*] Why is my car making crazy noises?
[/list]
[*] Real-time weather: The weather in the game is the same as where you live, using your IP address [i]safely[/i]
[*]Personalised advertising: Finally! After each game you will see ads personally created for you!
[*] Mac, Linux, Switch and GameCube support
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952534/462f70564a00310009ae103d94a0a8182a137570.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Everything completely reworked
[*] Changed sound system
[*] Changed jumpscares - creatures will visit you personally
[*] Changed Orbs *again*
[/list]

If you have any problems or want to give feedback, you can join the official Discord
https://discord.gg/KCS922fgBK

[i]Have a nice day[/i]
[i]Your developer Platuro[/i]

notes.title: Balancing Patch
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

In this patch the following things have changed:
[olist]
[*]The leveling system has been improved, it is now possible to get XP faster and difficult levels need a lower level to be unlocked
[*]The EMF screen has received some changes, it now displays the full 60 seconds of EMF
[*]During the EMF screen it is no longer possible to accidentally take photos, you can now exit the EMF screen simply by clicking on another tool button
[*]The ghosts have a slightly different beauvoir on different difficulty levels, such as showing evidence
[*]Some language problems have been improved
[/olist]

That's all for this first paranormal observation patch :)

Have fun!
